title: Having Problems
author: Alone_Tart_3775
selftext: Have spent all day trying to get UE5 to work on my device no luck so am going to take some time and figure things out on my end. Before I work on a demo again.

replies.author: Alone_Tart_3775
replies.body: UM that I am 53 years old and trying to learn this stuff on my own LOL. and that is why everything I do, and build is language based as the last program language I used was BASIC no joke. got it to download and open up got my project named and then couldn't figure out how to get my files from my device into UE5. As I said I am still learning but am going to try GODOT next. Thanks for the feedback.

replies.author: Alone_Tart_3775
replies.body: well, it was at least something back. and at least people are real and responding that is awesome to me.

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body:
I'm 59 and designing my first ever 3D game in Godot with Claude code and OpenCode.  

The combo of Claude Code and Godot is truly amazing.   
I recommend you instal this MCP for Claude to have more control over Godot   
[https://github.com/tugcantopaloglu/godot-mcp](https://github.com/tugcantopaloglu/godot-mcp)   

If you have any questions, just ask.

comments.author: Jolva
comments.body: I haven't used Unreal, but in Unity it's pretty easy. Are you using something like Claude Code? System like that could likely move the files to the right location for you via MCP.
